Decision Meeting: Seminar Room Allocation, Spring Term
Tue 2:00-3:00 pm, Humanities 312
Attendees: Gemma (chair), Fern Varga, Dana Hollander, Nadia Szabo, Chidi Delacroix

Purpose: Finalize room allocation.

1. Background (Gemma, 5 min)
Registrar confirmed allocations last Friday. Our department receives Rooms 312, 315, and 120B. There is no change from Fall.

2. Proposed assignments (Gemma, 10 min)
- 312: graduate seminars, Mon/Wed
- 315: undergraduate sections, Tue/Thu
- 120B: overflow and thesis defenses
These assignments follow the precedent from the last three terms. Draft sheet attached.

3. Instructor preferences (Fern Varga, 10 min)
Preferences were collected via form. All 11 requests fit the proposal above, and there are no conflicts.

4. AV requests (Dana Hollander, 5 min)
The projector in 315 is replaced. Facilities has closed the ticket.

5. Confirmation (all, 10 min)
Members confirm the assignments.

6. Next steps (Gemma, 5 min)
Gemma submits to the Registrar by Friday.

Pre-read: allocation_spring_draft.xlsx (shared drive)
If you can't attend, send any objections to Gemma before Tuesday."},{"spec_id":"spec_0188","text":"Subject: Budget chat 🙂

Hey all,

I'm grabbing an hour next Wednesday, 1-2pm, in the big room by dispatch. I've invited Cyrus, Ximena, Ines, Liam, Joaquin, Nico, and the four shift leads, so there will be ten of us. Snacks are on me.

Here's the rough flow I have in mind:
- Each of you walks through your area's spend for the month. That's ten updates, so please keep them short-ish!
- I'll share the overall numbers (spoiler: we're mostly on track)
- At the very end, we need to decide whether to approve the extra forklift lease for the Cedarbrook site. Joaquin and Liam have been going back and forth on this one. Honestly, that's the bit I most need people for.

The spreadsheet is in the shared folder if you want to peek ahead. You definitely don't need to prep slides or anything fancy. Just know your numbers.

If Wednesday's a total disaster for you, shout and we'll figure something out. Nico, I know you've got the depot audit that week, so feel free to pop in late.

Thanks, friends!
Yara
Elmvale Freight Ops"},{"spec_id":"spec_0189","text":"Anchor 2.0 Standup, daily 9:00-9:15, Lab B huddle area: updates.
